==Instructions==
This template is to be used for citing all [[StarWars.com]] content published before the official site's [https://web.archive.org/web/20120103174843/http://www.starwars.com/news/newstarwarscom.html revamp] on [[September 13]], [[2011]], or before the revamp of early [[2014]], and that wasn't kept available at least after this last revamp. Content from this period is identifiable either by the use of .html in filename (<nowiki>http://www.starwars.com/patch/filename.html</nowiki>) or by the complete removal of a selection of the website sections (and url paths) by early 2014 (ex: Shop). For pages on the Cargo Bay subdomain, use {{Tl|CargoBay}}.

For content kept online or published after the revamp of early 2014, use {{Tl|SW}}.

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{SWArchive|subdomain=|url=|text=|int=|author=|date=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} The URL of the page, minus <code><nowiki>http://www.starwars.com/</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|text}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive link''', see [[#backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|subdomain}} The subdomain part of the URL. The parameter must be filled with the part between <code><nowiki>http://</nowiki></code> and <code><nowiki>.starwars.com</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|int}} This field provides a link to the [[Wookieepedia]] article, if one exists.
*{{Para|author}} Name(s) of the author(s). Multiple authors must be separated with a "<code>;</code>" between their names. Note that an author is not necessarily an individual and could be an organization. A long list of authors can be reduced using "<code>, et al.</code>" after the first name. Provide wikilinks whenever they are available.
*{{Para|date}} Full date of publication, in [[Wikipedia:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format, for example "<code>date=2006-02-17</code>".
*{{Para|quote}} Relevant quote from the page. Double-quotes will be added automatically.
*{{Para|oldversion}} Set to 1 when the information is not present on the common ArchiveAccess archivedate's version of the webpage, necessitating a custom archivedate.

===Unneccesary parameters===
*{{Para|nolive}} As the original online content is no longer available, the template will automatically add "content now obsolete;" to the citation, and therefore does '''<u>NOT</u>''' require the use of "<code>|nolive=1</code>" like with other citation templates.

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{SWArchive|url=the_movies/saga/fifteenth_online_anniversary/index.html|text=''Star Wars'' Online: 15 Years Old Today|date=2010-07-15|archivedate=20110913132814}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{SWArchive|url=the_movies/saga/fifteenth_online_anniversary/index.html|text=''Star Wars'' Online: 15 Years Old Today|date=2010-07-15|archivedate=20110913132814}}

<hr />
;Using {{Para|int}}

<code><nowiki>{{SWArchive|url=vault/collecting/droids_ewoks_25th_anniversary/index.html|text=25 Years of Collecting ''Droids'' and ''Ewoks''!|int=25 Years of Collecting Droids and Ewoks!|author=Pete Vilmur|date=2010-09-07|archivedate=20110617035821}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{SWArchive|url=vault/collecting/droids_ewoks_25th_anniversary/index.html|text=25 Years of Collecting ''Droids'' and ''Ewoks''!|int=25 Years of Collecting Droids and Ewoks!|author=Pete Vilmur|date=2010-09-07|archivedate=20110617035821}}
